mostWorthwhile.text: Following the filtered fluid through recovery was most worthwhile: it showed why the kidney takes useful substances and water back rather than simply filtering out waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was clear but less interesting than following what happened to the fluid; the bladder was also the only offered combination at that point.

surprise.text: I was surprised that useful glucose and water pass through the filter along with waste and need to be recovered.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained the route, though the compatible pairings were offered rather than discovered.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: the filtering-then-recovery sequence made a body process understandable, though the straightforward fitting steps were less engaging.
